prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Rina M., Manoj bhai, Hetal didi, Rina didi.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 8:45 pm and 9:37 pm: 9 messages
- between 9:37 pm and 10:45 pm: 12 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "8:48 pm", "sender": "Rina M.", "text": "Aap sabne khana kha liya kya?"},

  {"time": "9:15 pm", "sender": "Rina M.", "text": "Bahut badiya, milkar baithke clear kar lenge."},
  {"time": "9:22 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Haan waise bhi aapas ka hi maamla hai."},
  {"time": "9:29 pm", "sender": "Rina didi", "text": "Waise chai ka kharcha kisne diya tha?"},
  {"time": "9:34 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Chai wala hisaab Hetal didi ne sambhal liya tha."},
  {"time": "9:40 pm", "sender": "Hetal didi", "text": "Sahi baat hai, baaki rashan ki list taiyar hai."},
  {"time": "9:44 pm", "sender": "Rina M.", "text": "Agli baar sab saath mein market chalte hain."},
  {"time": "9:49 pm", "sender": "Rina didi", "text": "Haan saath jaane mein aasan rahega."},
  {"time": "9:55 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Mujhe bhi kuch zaroori saman lena tha."},
  {"time": "10:01 pm", "sender": "Hetal didi", "text": "Toh phir sab saath milkar hi khareed lenge."},
  {"time": "10:07 pm", "sender": "Rina M.", "text": "Purana jo bhi baaki hai wo bhi dekh lenge."},
  {"time": "10:14 pm", "sender": "Rina didi", "text": "Bilkul, sab hisaab barabar hona chahiye."},
  {"time": "10:19 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Haan aapas mein koi tension nahi honi chahiye."},
  {"time": "10:25 pm", "sender": "Hetal didi", "text": "Chalo ab sab log aaram karo."},
  {"time": "10:31 pm", "sender": "Rina M.", "text": "Haan kafi late ho gaya hai."},
  {"time": "10:38 pm", "sender": "Rina didi", "text": "Good night sabhi ko."},
  {"time": "10:43 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Good night sabko, kal milte hain."}
]
